purpose: Develop and evaluate one recursively deployed D1 cache-maintenance trajectory from theta0 through theta8 on the selected KuaiRand large-model baseline

reference_matrix.role: opportunity evidence and edge-local endpoint reference, not the D1 output shape

model_sequence.source_state_rule: the deployed D1 output of edge theta_s_to_theta_t is the only cache source for edge theta_t_to_theta_t_plus_1

method_interface.input: previous deployed prefix K/V, immutable lineage metadata, current model, and label-free update-side fitting data
method_interface.output: current-version-compatible prefix K/V plus explicit lineage and work accounting
method_interface.fit_evaluation_separation: method fitting and hyperparameter selection must use records disjoint from the frozen qualification queries
method_interface.development_selection: candidate-level aggregate quality may be used on a disjoint development split; labels and realized gains may never enter the fitted transport features or deployed per-record action policy
method_interface.candidate_logging: retain every attempted candidate summary, including negative results; never replace or delete cells after observing quality

comparisons.same_request_requirement: all endpoints share current model, users, valid histories, query tokens, positives, and 99 frozen negatives
comparisons.gap_recovery_validity: report only when full_recompute_minus_recursive_reuse is positive; otherwise report NA and preserve all absolute endpoints
comparisons.result_shape: one ordered edge table and one cumulative summary, never another selected 8x8 method matrix

quality: absolute endpoint values for every reported metric
lineage: source cache origin and migration depth
proof that the previous method output was consumed
compute: algorithm-derived analytical operations from executed tensor shapes
all-recompute analytical operations on the same records
measured GPU time as a separate non-substitutable field

development_stages.name: foundation_preflight
development_stages.boundary: verify theta0, all theta1-theta8 checkpoints, matrix bindings, cache geometry, and disk/GPU contract

development_stages.name: single_edge_mechanism_canary
development_stages.boundary: run theta0_to_theta1 and theta1_to_theta2 on a small disjoint fit/development split; reject semantic or lineage failures before scaling

development_stages.name: recursive_prefix_validation
development_stages.boundary: continue the same deployed state through theta3 with no exact reset and compare recursive endpoints

development_stages.name: full_recursive_chain
development_stages.boundary: freeze one candidate and execute theta0_to_theta8 once, preserving every edge and cumulative summary

development_stages.name: cost_validation
development_stages.boundary: measure the frozen method on GPU0/GPU1 and compare theoretical accounting with observed time without changing quality semantics

promotion_boundary.selection_unit: whole recursive trajectory rather than individually cherry-picked edges
